newsitem.title: LEBANON: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: SOLIDERE shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: SOLIDERE shares were mixed in reduced turnover on Wednesday on the Beirut Stock exchange.
A shares fell slightly to $111.8750 from Tuesday's $112 and B shares were fractionally up to $115.250 from $115.125.
Turnover fell to 7,281 shares from 7,829 on Tuesday, and value was $812,106.5 from $881,833.75.
There was no trade for the third successive day this week in the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic . None of the shares were traded last week.
The LISPI stock index was unchanged from Tuesday's 84.10 and the BLOM stock index was almost unchanged, rising 0.003 percent to 969.06.
